svg.title: One conversation, three sessions
svg.desc: The running example. On 14 March the user says they have been strictly vegetarian for eight years, have a severe peanut allergy, and like Indian food. Four months later, on 20 July, they say they are pescatarian now, have moved to Kreuzberg, and that their sister Lena (who can't eat shellfish) is coming with her partner Jonas (coeliac). Six weeks after that, in a new conversation, they ask for dinner for 'my sister and her partner'. A correct answer needs six things: the new diet and not the old one (a fact that changes), no peanuts (a hard constraint), no shellfish and no gluten (people the question does not name, reached through two links), Indian food and somewhere near Kreuzberg.
svg.text: The test that every system in this series runs. The user changes a fact, keeps a hard constraint, and introduces two
people; the last session asks for something only right if all of it was kept.
